turnos.mensaje: I need help with my order.
I can help with that. Could you please provide your order ID? Once I have it, I can look up the status of your order.
Oh, sorry, I don't have the order ID handy. It was for a pair of running shoes I bought last week, though. Can you look it up using the email address on my account?

I'm sorry, but I can't look up orders by email address or by product description. I can only access an order when you provide its order ID. You can find the ID in your order confirmation email or in your account's order history. Once you have it, I'll be glad to check the status for you.

Also, the Nerds Store catalog focuses on accessories, peripherals and small electronics, so I'm not able to find running shoes in our product information.

Okay, I'll go check my confirmation email then. Also, are you sure you can't find it under my account? I'm pretty sure I bought the shoes through the Nerds Store site, so it should be there somewhere.

I'm sure I can't search your account. I don't have access to account records, and I can only look up an order when given its order ID. Your confirmation email or the order history in your account should show the ID. If you can't find it, you can contact support@nerdsstore.example during business hours (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM), and they can help you further.
Okay, thanks. While I'm checking my email, do you know if I can still return the shoes if they don't fit? I haven't even opened the box yet.

Our standard return window is 15 days. Items bought from clearance are not returnable, and opened headphones are not returnable. Our knowledge base doesn't include information about running shoes, so I can't confirm whether those shoes are eligible. Please check with support@nerdsstore.example to confirm eligibility for your specific item.

Okay, thanks. I'll dig through my inbox for that confirmation email. Quick question though, did you say the standard return window is 15 days? I bought them last Tuesday, so I think I'm still within that. Do I need the order ID for the return too,

Yes, the standard return window is 15 days. Since you bought the shoes last Tuesday, you should still be within it, though the exact date depends on when the order was placed and delivered.

Yes, you'll likely need the order ID for the return too, so support can locate your purchase. You can reach them at support@nerdsstore.example, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Got it, thanks. I'll dig through my inbox for that confirmation email and see if I can find the order ID. Appreciate the help!
You're welcome! Once you find the order ID, share it with me and I'll check the order status. Good luck with your search!
